subject: downloadHandler does not generate an actual file (in Windows)

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: downloadHandler does not generate an actual file (in Windows)
parts:
Hello, Shiny experts!

I can't figure out what's going on - everything seems to work but my app does not generate a file - although it looks like it does. Below is a very simple reproducible example:
Thank you very much for your help - I am really stuck here...

### my 'ui.R':

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  headerPanel("My App"),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    numericInput('NumRuns','Number of runs',value=3,min=3,max=10,step=1),
    
    actionButton(inputId="goButton","Run!"),
    
    textInput("downloadData","Save My Data Frame:",value="Data Frame 1"),
    downloadButton('downloadData','Save my file!')
    
  ),
  
  mainPanel(
    tabPanel("Some Text",
             h4(textOutput("caption2")),
             tableOutput("mydf"),
             value=3))
  ))


### my 'server.R':

shinyServer(function(input,output){
  

  # Creating files for download at the end
  
  myout = reactive({
    if(input$goButton==0) return(NULL)

      nrruns=input$NumRuns
      mylist=NULL
      for(i in 1:nrruns){
        mylist[[i]]<-data.frame(a=rnorm(10),b=runif(10))
        names(mylist)[i]<-paste("dataframe",i,sep="")
      }
      return(mylist)
  })
  
     output$mydf <- renderTable({
     if(input$goButton==0) return(NULL)
     input$goButton
     isolate(
       myout()$dataframe1
     )
   })
  
  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste(input$downloadData, " ",Sys.Date(),".csv",sep="") },
    content = function(file) {
      write.csv(myout()$dataframe1,file,row.names=F)
    }
  )
  
})

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: downloadHandler does not generate an actual file (in Windows)
parts:
File downloading is known to be not working when you run the app
inside the RStudio viewer. If that is your case, you can browse the
app in your web browser.

Regards,
Yihui
